From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@helixmetrics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA handoff + onboarding sync — propose consolidated session

Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for the productive intake call last week. Legal at HelixMetrics flagged a few redline items and our team would like to run a concise walkthrough so we can agree on next steps and an evidence handoff. To streamline scheduling, would you be open to a single consolidated session that covers: (1) MSA redline review (legal); (2) quick evidence checklist review (compliance); and (3) initial onboarding handoff (ops/technical).

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 23 May, 9:30–10:30am PT
- Wed 23 May, 1:00–2:00pm PT
- Thu 24 May, 10:00–11:00am PT

I’ve attached our latest redline (Redwood_MSA_v2_redline.pdf) and the evidence checklist (evidence-checklist.xlsx) for Marissa and your team to scan beforehand. If those windows don’t work, happy to break into two shorter calls.

Goals for the session:
- Align on the five open clauses in section 4/5 and agree a path to sign
- Confirm the evidence/attestation timeline and owner (vendor vs Redwood)
- Book the technical kickoff or identify a follow-up owner and timeline

Marissa — can you confirm the evidence items we expect Helix to deliver pre-sign?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Lead, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v2_redline.pdf (pdf), evidence-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@helixmetrics.com>

Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 11:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MSA handoff + onboarding sync — propose consolidated session

Kimberly —

Appreciate the note and the attachments. The team reviewed quickly and Wed morning looks tight for our legal lead. Thu 24 May at 10am PT would work on our side but we have one ask: can we add a short, separate slot at the end (15–20 minutes) to kick off the technical onboarding conversation with our integration lead? They want to confirm API scoping and a preliminary timeline. If it's easier we can keep the redline to 45 minutes and add a 20-minute ops block.

Also, our procurement group asked if you can include any SOC2 evidence pointers or a brief note on data retention policy during the session. I see an evidence checklist attached — we'll review and surface gaps.

Thanks — looping in Procurement Ops to book.

— Ethan
Ethan Moore
Sr. Head of Legal Operations
HelixMetrics
ethan.moore@helixmetrics.com
